mechanismOfAction.summary: NE and DA releaser (amphetamine-like mechanism); milder stimulant profile than amphetamine with minimal serotonergic activity.
mechanismOfAction.description: Oxazolinone CNS stimulant/antidepressant developed by Lederle Laboratories in the 1960s. Mechanism: norepinephrine and dopamine release (amphetamine-like), minimal serotonergic activity. Clinical antidepressant effect demonstrated at ~40 mg/day in historical trials. Discontinued. DEA controlled substance status indicated by multiple secondary sources (exact schedule unconfirmed in primary DEA sources).
